title: 0.2.21 reconnect recovery
summary: This update lets the offline reconnect button relaunch the local backend through Insta360_HW.exe, then poll the page back online automatically.
highlights: The offline banner now uses the local insta360-hw://reconnect protocol instead of only retrying failed fetches.
The launcher recognizes reconnect requests, starts or reuses the backend, and suppresses duplicate browser tabs.
The installer registers the reconnect URL protocol and the launcher repairs the current-user protocol registration on startup.
The launch script supports a NoOpen mode so the existing page can reconnect without opening waiting or platform pages.
compatibility: No data migration is required. Existing history, user plugins and local config are preserved.
